about: Per-build level checkpoints (stats, skills) and solo / MVP / PvP playstyle. Keyed by the build IDs in legion/builds.go. Stats and skills replay the engine's ordered plans at each gear-band end; gear is referenced by band only (legion/data/buildgear.json). The party role comes from code and is not repeated.

assumptions.stat_points: db/re/statpoint.yml (48 at level 1, 1273 at 99); every stat starts at 1; raising a stat from v costs (v-1)/10+2; job-level stat bonuses are not counted (the engine's plan reads base stats only)
assumptions.skill_points: Novice 9 (job 10), first job 39 (changes at job 40), second job 49 (job cap 50 for every second job on this server, db/re/job_exp.yml); a goal is raised only when the server's skill_tree.yml allows it
assumptions.pace: assumed: Novice job 10 by base 10, first job 40 at base 40, second job level = base level - 39 after the change; the engine changes jobs at job level 10 and 40 whatever the base level is, so the skill rows are approximate by up to a few levels either side
assumptions.vendors: vendor characters learn vendorFirst (Enlarge Weight Limit 5, Pushcart 3, Vending 3) before the plan's skills (builds.go planSkill). Merchant-line plans already start with these goals, so for them the replay is the same; a vendor of another line is not modelled (vendors are Merchant-line)
assumptions.ranges: gear bands from legion/data/buildgear.json (variants use their main plan's bands); a bands overlap, so 'by the end of the range' is the max level of the band
assumptions.gear: per range and slot: the curated best piece (last of the band's list) and up to 3 alternatives (affordable first, then fallback), each with its shop price or its drops (monster, rate at the server's item_rate multipliers, maps); affordable = shop price <= 2000 z per band level, or a drop <= 10 levels above the band top at 0.5 % or more. Source: the item, refine, mob and spawn tables of the running server.
assumptions.refine: target +7 for every refineable piece, +8 for weapon grades 2 and 5 (+7 for grades 1, 3, 4). cost_z = fee_z (NPC refine zeny) + ore_z (materials). The ore is priced at the NPC shop price where a shop sells it, else the item db Buy value; HD_ and Enriched_ ores take their base ore's Buy as a floor (their own Buy is 20, not a price). A material with no price is listed in unpriced and left out. Cheapest safe material per level, weighted by its chance; break_risk_pct is the chance of losing the piece. Estimate.
assumptions.cards: one-time bound: a card goes in at insert_at, the highest refine level the band pays for (budget 15000 z per band level). Tier from the non-MVP monster drops: popular (3+ monsters at 0.5 % or more), uncommon (0.1 %+, usable at any band; this threshold is the fixer's estimate, not an owner rule), rare (the rest). Rare cards only at band tops of 60+ with the full refine affordable, else the popular fallback in the same slot.

solo: Peco-mounted two-hander. Provoke the tough one, Two-Hand Quicken always up, Bowling Bash into any group of 3+, Magnum Break when swarmed. Hunts monsters 5-10 levels under its own on 1-3 monster spots.

Avoids ranged packs, stun/blind sources and Holy/Ghost mobs with no Endure up; sits on Increase HP Recovery between pulls and leaves under 30% HP (Fly Wing / Kafra). Carries Orange/White Potions, a Fly Wing, an Awakening Potion for dense spots.
mvp: Main tank or melee DPS: Provoke to hold the boss, Endure against knock-back, Two-Hand Quicken up, Bowling Bash only when adds crowd the boss. Stays in the priest's heal range.
Brings White Potions for the stack, Awakening/Berserk Potion for the kill window, Butterfly Wing for the party's save point.
pvp: Front-line bruiser: Two-Hand Quicken then Bowling Bash into the pack, Magnum Break to push melee off, Counter Attack against single melee, Endure so spells and hits do not flinch it.
Avoids long kiting and mage focus without Raydric/Matyr gear; carries White Potions, a Fly Wing and a Butterfly Wing; Yggdrasil Berry for the second wave.

solo: Peco-mounted holy tank. Faith and Auto Guard up, Holy Cross on 1-2 targets (best against Demon/Undead), Magnum Break as the low-level clear, Shield Boomerang to pull. Prefers Undead and Demon spots.
Avoids Holy-resistant monsters, big Ghost packs that hit through Auto Guard, and long farms with no healer; drinks White Potions and rests.
mvp: Main tank: Provoke, Auto Guard and Reflect Shield up, Holy Cross on Undead/Demon bosses, Grand Cross on grouped adds when it can afford the HP, Devotion on the priest.
Brings White and Blue Potions, Awakening Potion, Yggdrasil Berry.
pvp: Highest HP and DEF in the line: Auto Guard + Reflect Shield + Shield Boomerang, Holy Cross on single targets, Smite to stun; Sacrifice only next to a priest.
Avoids Ghost and Holy-immune targets and long fights without a healer; carries White Potions, Yggdrasil Berry, Fly Wing.

solo: AoE kiter. Fire Wall behind it, Storm Gust or Lord of Vermilion into a pulled pack (aimed at the centre monster), Thunder Storm to finish, Sight to find Hiding; stays at max range on Blue Potions. Spends an AoE only on 3+ monsters.
Avoids melee contact without a wall, Undead/Ghost packs resistant to its element, and long single-target grinds where SP runs dry; Fly Wing when cornered.
mvp: Burst from max range: Storm Gust / Lord of Vermilion on the adds, Jupitel Thunder and bolts on the boss, Meteor Storm on a standing pack, Quagmire when the boss closes (Safety Wall (not reached by the current plan)).
Brings Blue Potions and Blue Gemstones, Awakening Potion, Yggdrasil Berry; never stands in front of the tank.
pvp: Glass-cannon AoE: Storm Gust, Lord of Vermilion and Meteor Storm at range, Quagmire to slow melee, Fire Wall to hold a line, Jupitel Thunder to knock back; Frost Diver is its only single-target control.
Avoids anything that closes distance fast and Silence/Spell Breaker; carries Blue Potions, Fly Wing, Yggdrasil Berry.

solo: Bow kiter. Double Strafe with Improve Concentration, steps back 4-6 cells when a monster gets within 2, Arrow Shower on groups, Ankle Snare when it carries Traps, falcon Blitz Beat as a proc. Element arrows by target.
Avoids 3+ monsters on it, fast melee that closes the gap and spots without an arrow supply (buys 1k+ arrows). Fly Wing early.
mvp: Ranged DPS: Double Strafe on the boss with the right element arrow, Arrow Shower on adds, Ankle Snare when the boss chases, Blitz Beat on the side; stays behind the tank.
Brings Concentration/Awakening Potion, arrows by boss element, Traps, a Blue Potion, Fly Wing.
pvp: Mobile glass cannon: kite and Double Strafe, Ankle Snare to hold, Land Mine / Claymore as the trap line is learned, Blitz Beat to finish; dies to anything that closes the gap.
Avoids melee and Silence; carries Fire/Silver/Iron arrows, Traps, Concentration Potion, Fly Wing.

Avoids soloing anything above its level and melee early (VIT and DEX are low). Rests, buffs itself, keeps Blue Gemstones in stock.
mvp: Healer: Heal the tank first, Kyrie Eleison on the tank, Blessing and Increase AGI on all, Lex Aeterna on the boss before the big hit, Sanctuary on the tank's cell, Resurrection for the dead; stays out of melee range.
Brings Blue Gemstones (Sanctuary, Warp Portal), Holy Water, Blue Potions, Yggdrasil Berry; the party retreats if the priest dies.
pvp: Team support: Kyrie and Heal on the front line, Blessing / Increase AGI, Suffragium for casters, Resurrection after the fight; not a duelist.

solo: Peco-mounted spearman. Brandish Spear on groups of 3+ (aimed at the middle monster), Pierce on Large targets, Spear Boomerang to pull; Bash opens until Brandish is learned. AGI stays low so it farms slower mobs it out-heals.
Avoids fast small mobs (Pierce hits fewer times on Small) and anything it cannot out-heal; rests on Increase HP Recovery. Carries White Potions and a Fly Wing.
mvp: Tank/DPS on Large and Medium bosses: Provoke, Pierce / Brandish Spear on the boss and adds, Endure 10 against knock-back, Peco mount for HP and weight.
Brings White Potions, Awakening Potion, a Raydric garment for Neutral bosses, Butterfly Wing.
pvp: Spear burst: Pierce and Brandish Spear in the pack, Spear Stab to knock a caster out of range, Peco mount for HP; has no answer to ranged and Soul Strike mages.
Avoids open ground without a priest; carries White/Blue Potions, a Fly Wing and a Yggdrasil Berry.

Avoids Holy/Ghost-resistant monsters, packs of 8+ without Auto Guard (Grand Cross costs HP), and spots where it cannot rest.
mvp: Burst tank on Undead/Demon bosses: Provoke, Grand Cross when adds stack, Holy Cross to finish, Auto Guard against melee bosses. No Devotion until the plan reaches Reflect Shield.
Brings Blue Potions in bulk, White Potions, Yggdrasil Berry.
pvp: Area-burst crusader: Grand Cross on a cluster plus Auto Guard; dangerous to groups, weak to quick single targets and Silence.
Avoids mobile duelists and Holy-resist builds; carries Blue and White Potions, Fly Wing.

Avoids monsters it cannot kill before they close (AGI is low) and packs of 4+; kites all the time.
mvp: Falconer: Blitz Beat procs on the boss, Steel Crow keeps the falcon strong, Double Strafe when procs are off, Land Mine on the boss's path; stays back.
Brings arrows, Traps, Concentration Potion, a Blue Potion, Fly Wing.
pvp: Burst falconer: Blitz Beat procs ignore DEF; low AGI means it leans on Ankle Snare and Land Mine to stay alive.
Avoids anyone with a gap-closer; carries Traps, arrows, Fly Wing.

pvp: Holy zoner: Magnus Exorcismus walls against Undead/Demon, Sanctuary to hold a cell, Turn Undead; no answer to a normal Human duelist.
Avoids human duels; carries Blue Gemstones, Blue Potions, Fly Wing.

Avoids heavy weight (pushcart drag), magic-heavy mobs, long fights with no Adrenaline Rush; sells loot between trips.
mvp: Melee DPS: Adrenaline Rush for the party's ASPD, Over Thrust, Hammer Fall to stun adds, Maximize Power for the boss; stays on one flank.
Brings White Potions, Awakening/Berserk Potion, spare weapons for breakage.
pvp: Heavy hitter: Adrenaline Rush + Over Thrust + Maximize Power for burst, Hammer Fall to stun a group, Weapon Perfection to ignore size; low flee, so it dies to focus.
Avoids ranged poke; carries White Potions, spare weapons, Fly Wing, Yggdrasil Berry.

solo: Asura Strike burst. Builds 5 spheres, Fury (Explosion Spirits), casts Asura Strike to kill one tough monster or a pack, then drinks Blue Potions and rebuilds; slow and potion-heavy.
Avoids packs it cannot one-shot and any fight that lasts after the Asura (SP is empty for 20+ s); kills one big target at a time.
mvp: Boss burst: Fury and 5 spheres, Asura Strike for a huge chunk of the boss, then waits behind the tank until SP is back.
Brings 100+ Blue Potions, White Potions, Yggdrasil Berry, Butterfly Wing.
pvp: One-hit monk: Fury, 5 spheres, Asura Strike one-shots most targets in range, then it is helpless; needs a partner to cover the SP gap.
Avoids long fights; carries Blue Potions, Fly Wing, Butterfly Wing.

solo: STR/AGI Sonic Blow Assassin. Sonic Blow on every target worth it, Enchant Poison, Grimtooth, Right-hand Mastery for dual-wield when it has the second weapon; fastest single-target killer of the line.
Avoids packs of 4+ (Sonic Blow is single-target), Undead and Poison-immune targets; rests with Cloaking off.
mvp: Burst DPS: Sonic Blow combos on the boss with Enchant Poison, Grimtooth on adds from hiding; thin HP so it relies on flee and a healer.
Brings Red Gemstones (Venom Dust), White Potions, Awakening Potion, Fly Wing.
pvp: Burst striker: Sonic Blow one-chains most squishies, Enchant Poison adds damage; dies to AoE and stun.
Avoids Safety Wall stalls and tank builds; carries White Potions, Fly Wing, Yggdrasil Berry.

solo: AGI/STR Dagger Assassin. Dual daggers (Right-hand and Left-hand Mastery), Enchant Poison, Venom Splasher on weak targets, Venom Dust for groups, Cloaking; Poison React to survive single poison hitters.
Avoids Poison-immune Undead/Insect, big packs without Venom Dust, long chases; leaves under 30% HP.
mvp: Dual-dagger DPS: Double Attack + Left/Right mastery and Enchant Poison on the boss, Venom Splasher for burst, Cloaking when it needs to reset aggro.
Brings Red Gemstones (Venom Dust), White Potions, Awakening Potion.
pvp: Dual-wield duellist: fast hits with Enchant Poison, Venom Splasher as a finisher, Poison React to counter poison users; low defence.
Avoids AoE and stun; carries White Potions, Red Gemstones, Fly Wing.

solo: Spear Crusader. Spear Quicken up for ASPD, Peco mount, Holy Cross and Grand Cross on packs, Bash for the first hit; STR/VIT so it trades hits for a long time on 1-3 monster spots.
Avoids ranged/magic packs and Holy-immune targets; rests to full before the next pull.
mvp: Spear tank-DPS: Provoke, Spear Quicken and spear damage on Large bosses, Holy Cross on Undead/Demon, Grand Cross for adds.
Brings White Potions, Awakening Potion, Yggdrasil Berry, Butterfly Wing.
pvp: Mounted spearman: Spear Quicken for ASPD, Holy Cross burst, Smite and Shield Boomerang for control; solid HP, no ranged answer.
Avoids ranged kiting and Silence; carries White Potions, Awakening Potion, Fly Wing.

pvp: Crowd control: Storm Gust freeze then Lord of Vermilion, Frost Diver on a lone attacker, Ice Wall to cut a lane, Quagmire to slow melee.
Avoids freeze-immune and Undead opponents and Silence; carries Blue Potions, Fly Wing, Yggdrasil Berry.

solo: Auto Spell Sage. Hindsight procs Fire / Cold / Lightning Bolt on its melee swings (Soul Strike versus Undead), AGI for ASPD, Free Cast to keep moving. Stands in melee with a Book.
Avoids low-SP stretches and Ghost mobs for the wrong bolt; leaves when VIT-1 HP runs low (Fly Wing).
mvp: Melee-caster DPS: Hindsight bolt procs on the boss, Free Cast, Dispell (not reached by the current plan); relies on the tank for aggro and a priest for heals (VIT is low).
Brings Blue Potions, Awakening Potion, Concentration Potion for ASPD.
pvp: Auto Spell duelist: high ASPD means frequent proc bolts, Free Cast keeps it mobile; no VIT, so one stun or Silence ends the fight.
Avoids open fights without an escape; carries Blue Potions, Fly Wing, Yggdrasil Berry.

solo: Trapper. Claymore Trap (2 Traps) or Land Mine on the cell the monster walks to, Blast Mine / Freezing Trap / Sandman to control, falcon Blitz Beat for the rest; kites around its traps. Needs a Trap stock (50z each) and restocks every trip.
Avoids running out of Traps, 4+ monsters without Claymore, fast flyers.
mvp: Trap control: Ankle Snare + Claymore Trap on the boss's path, Freezing Trap / Sandman on adds, Land Mine for burst, Blitz Beat from range. Long prep, little SP.
Brings 60+ Traps, a Blue Potion, Concentration Potion, Fly Wing.
pvp: Trap field: Ankle Snare, Land Mine, Claymore and Shockwave Trap (SP drain) around the party's line; strong holding a spot, weak when ambushed.
Avoids open rushes; carries many Traps, arrows, Fly Wing.

solo: Tank-ish Monk. Occult Impaction (Investigate) as the damage skill, Mental Strength (Steel Body: huge DEF/MDEF, but slow) against packs, Triple Attack combos for finishing, Dodge; VIT/STR makes it a slow, safe solo farmer.
Avoids long fights at low SP and spots where being slowed is fatal; rests with Spiritual Cadence.
mvp: Off-tank: Mental Strength (Steel Body) while the boss swings, Occult Impaction burst, Root (Blade Stop) to hold a melee boss, combos when SP allows.
Brings Blue and White Potions, Yggdrasil Berry, Awakening Potion.
pvp: Durable duelist: Steel Body gives huge DEF/MDEF at the price of speed, Occult Impaction burst, Root to stop one melee attacker; easy to kite.
Avoids fast kiters; carries Blue and White Potions, Fly Wing, Yggdrasil Berry.
